The list's place, name and row form are deferred to the epoch that brings stage 1 MF1 (26q:56): an explicit deferral, and until then nothing is scored (26q:60-61). (2) a run on a planted tree has only its own list; none of its observations is written to findings.jsonl or unresolved.jsonl (26q:57-59). (3) the two-file command stays as built: a JSON list of findings as the fixtures give it, {"hits": n}, no report, no verdict, nothing written, run by no job; relaxation L-AH1 lets that command alone take fingerprints as given (26q:64-70); the bootstrap referee judges it on the match vectors, so it can be red there though /vec/cases.json shows no such case (26q:71-73). (4) rules_total is neither the run's cases' tool nor the library: it is the rule set of the target's census vector, per the tool the vector names; a vector rule the library cannot produce stays in the denominator; a case of a rule outside the set adds nothing to rules_total or rules_covered and is still a case (n, recall, misses, FAIL on a miss), named beside the report; a target without a vector has no census and never PASS (26q:74-80, 26e:72-73, 29za:9-22). Update (b): every observation is in the list, so a re-observed finding is readable in the run that saw it (26q:49-52); a planted line with the fingerprint of another violation in the same file is refused by cases.build (26q:62-63). The stated consequence (a live cycle's cases all misses) is answered: in a cycle with no hunter run on the case's snapshot no harness report is scored, the target's line names it, the verdict is neither FAIL nor PASS, no miss is made up (26q:60-61). Every item has a rule or a named deferral; no successor.
